productionRules.targetCardDurationSeconds: 480–570 when coherent; never pad short cards

lessons.title: How Much Is This?
lessons.concreteSituation: A learner holds an item at a small shop and wants to pay by card.
lessons.learnerInput: Hear the clerk and the customer exchange a price and payment choice.
lessons.expectedOutput: Ask the price and say how you will pay without looking at the text.
lessons.independentProductionPrompt: Point to another item and ask its price in Korean.

acquisitionCues.physical: Hold an item and point to the price tag.
acquisitionCues.sound: Hear and say the price question and payment choice.
acquisitionCues.graphic: A shop-counter image and the written price on the tag.
acquisitionCues.meta: Choose 이거 or 저거 for a different item.

lessons.title: I Have a Reservation
lessons.concreteSituation: A learner arrives at a hair salon and speaks to the receptionist.
lessons.learnerInput: Hear the greeting, reservation statement, name question and invitation to enter.
lessons.expectedOutput: Say you have a reservation and give your name.
lessons.independentProductionPrompt: Arrive at a salon and tell the receptionist your own name.

acquisitionCues.physical: Walk up to a salon reception desk.
acquisitionCues.sound: Hear and say a reservation and name.
acquisitionCues.graphic: A booking list with a highlighted name.
acquisitionCues.meta: Transfer the exchange to a clinic or restaurant reservation.

lessons.title: My Stomach Hurts
lessons.concreteSituation: A patient tells a clinician where it hurts; no treatment advice is given.
lessons.learnerInput: Hear a short question about pain and a simple description of its severity.
lessons.expectedOutput: State the painful body part and whether the pain is severe.
lessons.independentProductionPrompt: Point to a body part and describe the pain in one Korean sentence.

acquisitionCues.physical: Point to the part of the body that hurts.
acquisitionCues.sound: Hear and say the symptom in a short exchange.
acquisitionCues.graphic: A simple body diagram with the painful area marked.
acquisitionCues.meta: Swap 배 for 머리 or another familiar body part.

lessons.title: My Phone Isn't Working
lessons.concreteSituation: A learner shows a phone that is not working at a repair counter.
lessons.learnerInput: Hear a simple problem report and a follow-up question about charging.
lessons.expectedOutput: Say the phone is not working and answer whether it was charged.
lessons.independentProductionPrompt: Show a device that is not working and ask for help in Korean.

acquisitionCues.physical: Show the inactive phone screen to a worker.
acquisitionCues.sound: Hear and say a short problem report.
acquisitionCues.graphic: An unlit phone icon and a charging cable.
acquisitionCues.meta: Use 안 돼요 to report a different everyday problem.

lessons.title: Where Do I Apply?
lessons.concreteSituation: A learner points to a service desk and asks where to submit an application.
lessons.learnerInput: Hear a location question, a direction, and a confirmation.
lessons.expectedOutput: Ask which counter to visit and confirm the indicated place.
lessons.independentProductionPrompt: At an unfamiliar counter, ask where to apply, using no written prompt.

acquisitionCues.physical: Point from one service counter toward another.
acquisitionCues.sound: Hear and say the place question and confirmation.
acquisitionCues.graphic: A simple two-counter sign with one counter highlighted.
acquisitionCues.meta: Reuse 어디에서 for a new action such as waiting.

lessons.title: Please Check Again
lessons.concreteSituation: A learner sees the wrong name on a café pickup label.
lessons.learnerInput: Hear a polite correction and the worker's check-back response.
lessons.expectedOutput: Say the label does not show the learner's name and request another check.
lessons.targetConstruction: 제 이름이 아니에요. / 다시 확인해 주세요.
lessons.independentProductionPrompt: Point to an incorrect name and ask the worker to check it again.

acquisitionCues.physical: Point to a name on a pickup label.
acquisitionCues.sound: Hear and say a short correction and request.
acquisitionCues.graphic: A name label showing a different name.
acquisitionCues.meta: Replace 이름 with another incorrect detail, such as 번호.
